          About PAIvik

          A little order. More discovery.

          PAIvik turns scattered notes, images and data into a living research graph. Helpers propose. You decide.

          01 · Sort the incoming

          Suggest a project, pick out sample and experiment IDs, and flag missing fields.

          02 · Make the connections

          Propose links between an observation, an experiment and the exact protocol version used.

          03 · Keep the record healthy

          Surface possible duplicates, broken references and conflicting metadata for review.

          How this version works

          • Everything stays in your browser. Records, files and voice notes are stored with IndexedDB on this device. Use Export to keep a copy or move it to another browser.
          • The gardener is rule-based. It matches IDs, names and file types. It runs no AI model, local or cloud.
          • Fast, and fixable afterwards. Captures wait in the inbox and suggestions wait in Review, but your own click is the decision: no second confirmation. Undo is offered right after, and every change keeps its exact before/after under Review → Decided changes.
          • Optional lab mode. When a lab hosts this page next to its PAIvik gateway, a Ticker, a PCR Planner, a Seminar that puts itself together from the Ticker, and a Lab map of fridges, freezers and instruments appear. Their data lives on the lab's server and notebook, not in this browser; changes are written in your name with your own notebook key, and model-drafted changes are still approved on the lab's review page. On this public page lab mode is off.

          Where it is going

          The notebook companion

          Talk after an experiment, drop in a photo, and turn it into a reviewable notebook update.

          The protocol studio

          Keep a protocol connected to its experiments, then turn the practice into a teachable lesson.

          The project garden

          A living map of questions, experiments, datasets and decisions across a project.

          Planned connections, not yet part of this browser version: Carpentries Workbench lessons, protocols.io, and small local models for tagging, extraction and link suggestions. The PAIvik lab notebook (eLabFTW) is reached only in lab mode, through the lab's own gateway.

          Models will change. Your research should endure.
